snippet.title: Wild Dawn: Chapter 2 Preview Trailer | FragPunk
snippet.description:
Wild Dawn: Chapter 2 Early Access Begins April 25.

New Card, New Mode, New Map, and New Lancer— ready to tear up the rulebook.
Let’s take a peek into the chaos to come.

#FragPunk #BreakTheRules 

FragPunk hits the console on April 29! 🎮
Xbox: https://xbox.com/games/store/fragpunk/9mw715j1p29d
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10012871/
